title: [2.8-3.0][Usability] Change pump reconnect icon to be green
body:
Currently, loop reconnect icon is exact same gray colour like icons used to disconnect pump.
It is confusing while on reconnect dialog it is not aparent that reconect icon do positive action and resumes pump and loop.

As a proposed fix - reconnect icon `ic_loop_reconnect `colour should be changed from gray (`@color/loopDisconnected`) to green (`@color/loopClosed`)

comments.body: I will work on PR to fix that
